test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest ethnic group in Myanmar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bamar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bamar:-**

 
 
• It is the dominant ethnic group in Myanmar, comprising approximately 68% of the country's population.
 
 
 
• **Myanmar: **
 
 
• **Myanmar, also known as Burma, is a country in Southeast Asia.**
 
• It is bordered by Bangladesh, India, China, Laos, and Thailand.
 
• The country has a diverse population with over 135 ethnic groups, each with its own language and culture.
 
• The official language of Myanmar is Burmese, and the majority of the population practices Buddhism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karen:-**

 
 
• They are also known as Kayin.
 
• They are the second-largest ethnic group in Myanmar, comprising around 7% of the population.
 
 
 
• **Shan:-**
 
 
• They are the third-largest ethnic group in Myanmar, comprising around 9% of the population.
 
• They are primarily concentrated in the Shan State.
 
 
 
• **Rohingya:-**
 
 
• They are a minority Muslim ethnic group in Myanmar, comprising around 1% of the population.
 
• They have faced persecution and violence in Myanmar and have been forced to flee to neighboring countries.
